coder_notes: mRNA lipid-particle vaccine is a cancer vaccine (excluded intervention type). Stratum 1 adult GBM, Stratum 2 pediatric HGG up to age 25 (includes adults, ages include CHILD). Temozolomide is not a registered intervention; listed because the protocol text refers to TMZ with radiation for Stratum 1 patients. An antiepileptic 'such as levetiracetam' is required but no drug is named definitively, so not listed. BRAFV600E+ is an exclusion for Stratum 2, coded as eligibility biomarker for completeness.
